observations.claim: The audit-journal service logs multiple errors indicating 'no space left on device' for /var/journal, showing the journal is full.
The audit-journal service logs warnings about the /var/journal volume being at 91% and 98% capacity, indicating disk space is critically low.
The intake-api service logs errors of submission rejections due to audit journal write failures, returning 507 errors to clients.
The intake-api service logs a warning about an unrecognized client user-agent, but this is unrelated to the widespread submission rejections.

suggested_checks: Check disk usage and free space on the /var/journal volume of the audit-journal service.
Verify audit-journal retention and compaction processes to ensure they are functioning and not blocked.
Review intake-api error logs for 507 responses and correlate with audit-journal errors.
